title: useResource
subtitle: Own a Resource for the component lifetime
description: Creates a resource, subscribes to its snapshot, recreates when config.key changes, destroys on unmount.

signature.code: useResource<T, R = T>(config: ResourceConfig<T, R>): ResourceSnapshot & Actions & { resource: Resource<T, R> }

rows.name: config
rows.description: Same config as createResource. Identity changes when config.key changes.

returns.description: Spread snapshot fields plus bound actions

examples.title: Entity editor
Key change = new identity
Create mode
Loading / error / saving UI

dos: Pass resource into leaf components with useField
Include route ids in config.key when using persist
donts: Don't put the entire form in one component that only uses useResource snapshot for every keystroke
Don't expect config changes other than key to recreate the instance
